title: On successful completion the upload surface renders an assertive-slot announcement and per-file remove and retry controls
asA: operator whose upload set has just finished
iWant: an assertive-slot announcement saying how many files uploaded successfully, plus a keyboard-reachable remove control per completed file
soThat: my screen reader tells me the set is done and I can remove a file I no longer want without a page reload

acceptanceCriteria.description: After the fixture completes the upload set the upload region carries a [data-assertive-slot] element with aria-live="assertive" or role="status" whose textContent matches /^\d+ files uploaded successfully$/, each completed file row carries [data-file-row][data-file-state="complete"], a keyboard-reachable [data-recovery="remove"] button per row and, after a refused-then-succeeded row, a [data-recovery="retry"] button visible only until the retry succeeds.
